Original website layout and analytical SVG redraws created for this portfolio. No generated bitmap or stock business imagery is used.

Evidence sources: FDIC bank records, EIA-861 reliability schedules, CFPB/HMDA 2025 originated loans and the UCI Bike Sharing dataset.
UCI dataset: Fanaee-T, H. (2013), Bike Sharing, DOI 10.24432/C5W894, CC BY 4.0.
Selected source files, hashes and graphic inputs: evidence.json.
Analytical code and source documentation: https://github.com/Pratattack/analytics-portfolio

The portfolio uses the approved editorial design across its homepage, library and case studies. Original analytical source files remain separate from site presentation copies.
